products.subtitle_zh: 开放式客餐厨｜厨房中岛台｜大尺寸户外露台

products.subtitle_en: Open-Plan Kitchen/Dining | Kitchen Island | Large Covered Outdoor Deck
products.description_en: Two independent bedrooms with dual triple-door wardrobes, open-plan living/kitchen/dining with island, full bathroom and laundry, wide deck extending outdoor living. Ideal for family living or long-term rental.

products.subtitle_zh: 两端独立卧室｜开放式公共区｜带顶露台门廊

products.subtitle_en: Bedrooms at Both Ends | Open-Plan Living Area | Covered Deck & Verandah
products.description_en: Bedrooms positioned at opposite ends for maximum privacy, each with triple-door wardrobes. Central open-plan living/kitchen/dining space with covered verandah and deck. Ideal for co-living or multi-generational families.

products.subtitle_zh: 主卧独立套内卫浴｜公共卫浴洗衣｜大户外露台

products.subtitle_en: Master Bedroom Ensuite | Guest Bathroom & Laundry | Large Outdoor Deck
products.description_en: Master bedroom with private ensuite, second bedroom with large wardrobe, open-plan living/kitchen/dining, dual bathroom configuration. Ideal for multi-occupant or high-privacy living scenarios.

products.subtitle_zh: 客区半卫设计｜厨房中岛｜宽敞带顶门廊露台

products.subtitle_en: Guest Half Bath | Kitchen Island | Spacious Covered Deck

products.description_en: Three bedrooms with triple-door wardrobes, master with private ensuite, shared bathroom/laundry, and open-plan lounge/dining/kitchen. End-entry porch for outdoor living. Ideal for family occupancy or multi-generational living on larger lots (QLD ~80 m²).

products.subtitle_en: Central Entry | Dual Full Baths | Wide Front Deck

products.description_en: Two bedrooms with wardrobes, ensuite plus full bathroom/laundry, open kitchen/dining and lounge, and an end-entry porch with deck. Clear zoning between sleep and living — practical for self-occupancy or rental.
